intro: Belize is the only English-speaking country in Central America, with Maya ruins, rainforest and a huge barrier reef.

chapters.title: Maya cities
text: Caracol was a great Maya city whose Caana pyramid is still the tallest human-made structure in Belize. Altun Ha, Xunantunich and Lamanai are other sites.

chapters.title: British Honduras
text: British loggers, called Baymen, settled from the 1600s to cut logwood and mahogany, using enslaved Africans. In 1798 they defeated a Spanish fleet at St George's Caye. Britain made it the colony of British Honduras in 1862.

highlight.title: St George's Caye
highlight.text: The 1798 battle is celebrated every 10 September.

chapters.title: Independence
text: Belize became independent in 1981, but British troops stayed for years because Guatemala claimed the territory. The dispute is now before the International Court of Justice.

keyTerms.meaning: A tree used to make dye.
